abstract: In prior notices, the U.S. Trade Representative modified the actions in the section 301 investigation of China's acts, policies, and practices related to technology transfer, intellectual property, and innovation by excluding from additional duties certain products of China, including medical-care products needed to address COVID. In December 2022, the U.S. Trade Representative determined to extend 352 previously reinstated exclusions through September 30, 2023 and in May 2023 determined to extend 77 COVID-related exclusions through September 30, 2023. This notice announces the U.S. Trade Representative's determination to further extend the 352 reinstated exclusions and 77 COVID-related exclusions until December 31, 2023.

agencies.name: Trade Representative, Office of United States
agencies.raw_name: OFFICE OF THE UNITED STATES TRADE REPRESENTATIVE

dates: The extensions in this notice extend the 352 reinstated exclusions and 77 COVID-related exclusions through December 31, 2023. U.S. Customs and Border Protection will issue instructions on entry guidance and implementation.
title: Notice of Extension for Product Exclusions: China's Acts, Policies, and Practices Related to Technology Transfer, Intellectual Property, and Innovation
